**Solution Engineer, Data & AI**

**Help Denmark’s leading organizations turn data into real-world impact**

Do you believe the best Data & AI solutions are built by people who are curious, pragmatic and willing to challenge conventional thinking?

We are looking for a **Solution Engineer, Data & AI** to join Microsoft’s Cloud & AI Solution Engineering team in Denmark. You will work with some of Denmark’s most ambitious organisations, helping them modernise their data platforms, prepare their data for AI and turn new technology into measurable business outcomes.

This is not a traditional pre-sales role. You will combine deep technical expertise with creativity, commercial understanding and a hands-on approach. You will engage directly with customers, shape technical strategy and prove what is possible through architecture workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototyping, proofs of concept and collaborative build engagements.
